context: Asuka prepares to run a marathon; Tatsuya gently teases her about it.
purpose: Couple lovingly teasing during fitness training.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: マラソン、来月本番なの。
lines.style: Matter-of-fact opening, gentle undercurrent of anticipation. Soft, grounded tone — stating a fact that matters. Steady pace, no bravado.

lines.speaker: tatsuya_country
lines.style: Quiet admiration, unhurried. Lean into the pause before speaking — genuine, not performative. Warm drawl on the vowels. The kind of praise that sits easy.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.en: I wonder if I can finish it.
lines.style: Vulnerable underneath. Soft on the opening; hesitation gathering around the conditional. Honest doubt, not self-pity. Slight uplift at the end like asking permission to worry out loud.

lines.speaker: tatsuya_country
lines.jp: 練習、ようけしとるやろ?
lines.en: You've been putting in the work, haven't you?
lines.style: Knowing, reassuring half-statement. Patient pause before speaking — the voice of someone who sees effort others miss. Warm, steady, like a hand on the shoulder.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.en: Yeah, I've really given it everything.
lines.style: Quiet pride. Soft confidence without strain. The satisfaction of honest effort. Warm, settled tone — not boasting, just stating what is true.
